'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 John Veasey DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' John Veese
* '''Deck name:''' Back in the City
* '''Username:''' Veez
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
